answers.1:
kubectl patch deploy web -n $NS -p '{"spec":{"strategy":{"type":"Recreate","rollingUpdate":null}}}'
kubectl get deploy web -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.spec.strategy.type}'

# rollingUpdate 를 null 로 비우지 않으면 "may not be specified when strategy type is Recreate" 오류가 난다
answers.2:
kubectl rollout pause deploy/web -n $NS
kubectl set image deploy/web nginx=nginx:1.26 -n $NS
kubectl set env deploy/web MODE=blue -n $NS
kubectl rollout resume deploy/web -n $NS
kubectl rollout status deploy/web -n $NS --timeout=120s
kubectl rollout history deploy/web -n $NS

# 개정이 1, 2 두 개뿐이다. 중지하지 않았다면 3개가 된다
answers.3:
kubectl patch deploy web -n $NS -p '{"spec":{"minReadySeconds":10}}'
kubectl get deploy web -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.spec.minReadySeconds}'

# 기본값은 0. readinessProbe 와 함께 쓰면 "준비"와 "안정"을 따로 확인한다
answers.4:
kubectl patch deploy web -n $NS -p '{"spec":{"revisionHistoryLimit":1}}'
for i in nginx:1.26 nginx:1.27-alpine nginx:1.26-alpine; do
  kubectl set image deploy/web nginx=$i -n $NS
  kubectl rollout status deploy/web -n $NS --timeout=120s
done
kubectl get rs -l app=web -n $NS

# limit 가 기본(10)이면 ReplicaSet 이 4개 남는다
answers.5:
kubectl create deployment web2 -n $NS --image=busybox:1.36 --replicas=2 -- sleep 3600
kubectl rollout status deploy/web2 -n $NS --timeout=120s
kubectl get deploy web2 -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.spec.template.spec.containers[0].command}'

# -- 앞은 kubectl 옵션, 뒤는 컨테이너 명령이다
answers.6:
kubectl create -n $NS -f /tmp/lab/gen.yaml
kubectl create -n $NS -f /tmp/lab/gen.yaml
kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready pod -l app=gen -n $NS --timeout=90s
kubectl get pod -l app=gen -n $NS

# run-x7k2p, run-9fhzq 처럼 이름이 달라진다. apply 는 이름이 없어 실패한다
answers.7:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: {name: sp}
spec:
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 0
  shareProcessNamespace: true
  containers:
  - {name: web, image: "nginx:1.25"}
  - {name: dbg, image: "busybox:1.36", command: ["sleep", "3600"]}
EOF
kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready pod/sp -n $NS --timeout=90s
kubectl exec sp -n $NS -c dbg -- ps

# 공유하면 PID 1 이 pause 프로세스가 되고 nginx 도 목록에 보인다
answers.8:
kubectl set image deploy/web nginx=nginx:1.26 -n $NS
kubectl rollout status deploy/web -n $NS --timeout=120s
kubectl annotate deploy/web -n $NS kubernetes.io/change-cause='upgrade to 1.26'
kubectl rollout history deploy/web -n $NS

# 사유가 CHANGE-CAUSE 칸에 나타난다. 배포 때마다 사유를 갱신한다
answers.9:
kubectl get rs -l app=web -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.items[?(@.status.replicas>0)].metadata.name}' > /tmp/q9.txt
cat /tmp/q9.txt
